new_primitive.construction: Conventional directed savings merge, four adaptive descent neighborhoods, two bounded route-fragment rebuilds. No algorithmic novelty, causal necessity or retained superiority claim.
new_primitive.purpose: Directed order-level temporal route feasibility and driving-only objective with exact capacity and depot return; K1 typed-slot matching does not provide these semantics.

resource_counter.budget_end: Search preserves a checked feasible incumbent. Optional next checks stop at hard cap, absent next witness causes current dispatch; final safety reuses previously checked same-departure immutable Routes if no checks remain. If no complete feasible cover has been constructed within budget, the policy reports unresolved, never proved infeasible.
resource_counter.economic_cost: Measured later by broker; actual host/model billing unknown. Included generation is not zero economic cost.
resource_counter.scope: Every Oracle.check invocation, including infeasible/empty candidates, current singleton construction, next-departure singleton safety, nonmetric enumeration, merge, all local candidates, fragment safety, next-route deferral witnesses and fresh final safety. Stored immutable evaluated Routes and their cost sums are reused without another complete-route evaluation. Raw directed arc/deadline shortlists and partial-path pruning do not evaluate complete routes.
